name: Team Play
summary: Partner card game where teammates collect number sets to complete point-scoring missions.
rules_text: For 3-6 players. With 4 players teams are 1-3 vs 2-4, with 6 players 1-4, 2-5, 3-6; with 3 or 5 players you play solo. Each player has 1 face-up Mission card (2 if odd player count) plus a central general Mission, and a hidden hand of Number cards (1-8 in red/blue) with a bank of 3 face-up numbers. On your turn first discard down to 6 cards if needed (8 if solo). Then in any order: draw 2 Number cards from bank or deck, replenishing bank; optionally fulfill any number of Missions by discarding the exact required combination from hand; and optionally give 1-2 cards face-down to your partner. Replaced Missions are drawn from the Mission deck. When a team completes its 8th Mission (5th solo) each player gets one final turn, then sum mission points, most wins, tie fewest missions wins.
rating_reason: Partner mission card game with hidden hands and team strategy.
